Someone (maybe Jeff Bescole) wrote:

"But he indicates no sympathy for the kind of biocentric "deep
ecology" and bioregionalism espoused by most of them, and his concerns
are
exclusively anthropocentric, his appreciation of other species and
natural
systems nil. He also mocks those who believe in the "Gaia theory" of a
living earth, common in many environmental groups: 'Do its adherents
REALLY
believe in it or are they just play-acting?' "

Is there

> >>any evidence that TK was interested in Native
> >>American religions, which are in many respects
> >>pantheistic? Certainly TK was a rather spiritual
> >>man, albeit in a rather twisted sense.
> >>
> >>                                  ---ICE TIGER
> >>
